domestic.scope: Read-only development diagnostic: 2021/2023 H2 policy selection and fixed-policy 2022/2024 audits only; no 2025+ data read or threshold retuning
domestic.selection_basis: Highest minimum precision lower bound across both next-year single-seed audits among candidates with sufficient evidence; not a claim of profitable edge

walk_2022.why_not_stricter: Higher cutoffs raised point precision but .55/.60 had lower precision confidence lower bounds than .50; .65 had only 8 events across 4 days and 8 symbols. Every eligible net-return lower bound was negative. No joint stop-cap candidate had sufficient evidence.

walk_2024.why_not_stricter: Only .50 had enough evidence. .55 had 37 events and 18 signal days; .60 had 6 events across 5 days and 5 symbols; .65 and higher had no signals. The .50 net-return lower bound remained negative. Joint stop caps left at most 3 events.

previous_deep_ensemble_same_count_2024_d.comparison_limitation: Equal count and historical period, not a new independent test; new pipeline also changes features, training cap, target augmentation and calibration partitions, so this is not a causal architecture ablation

native_feature_importance.method: CatBoost PredictionValuesChange averaged equally over seeds42/43/44
native_feature_importance.caveat: Training-model prediction variation, not held-out permutation importance, causal effects, or tradable alpha. Correlated range and gap features can share importance.

interpretation: The higher-confidence tail becomes extremely small; rare signals are allowed, but 6 or 8 events do not establish stable high precision.
In 2021 H2 stricter eligible thresholds increase observed precision without improving its conservative lower bound; in 2023 H2 only the baseline .50 cutoff retains enough evidence.
The selected architecture is best relative to the tested candidates, not good enough in absolute terms. Both development audits fail the predeclared precision and cost-adjusted return requirements.
The 2024 new ensemble improves observed precision versus the prior deep ensemble, but its 16.43bp gross mean daily proxy remains below the assumed20bp round-trip cost.

Past ranges and current opening gap dominate native importance. This is consistent with learning barrier reachability/volatility structure, but does not prove the cause of failures or establish future direction.

Neither deeper networks nor confidence thresholding adds unobserved post-entry intraday path information. Future performance and the distinct contribution of architecture cannot be established from this diagnostic.

US/deep probabilities are not invariant across CUDA BF16 inference batch sizes: original2048 versus new8192 differs by max0.000861315580045735; actual same-batch reruns reproduce saved values and all signal masks remain identical. Do not imply bitwise reproducibility across batch sizes.
limitations: No DB or minute/tick prices read: cannot independently establish actual OPEN/CLOSE market fills or intraday ordering.
Market-value arithmetic is checked, but held-position price marks are not re-queried.
Per-entry 5-percent opening-notional budget depends on unsaved opening marks; fixed configuration and position/liquidity caps are checked.
Daily label, survivor/availability selection, assumed fill, cost model and reused-history research limitations remain.

reproducibility_note.cause: Actually isolated batch-size-dependent CUDA BF16 arithmetic; full original-batch and aligned new-batch recomputations each exactly reproduce their corresponding saved probabilities.

resolved_findings.resolution: The strict across-batch 1e-5 equality assumption was isolated as inappropriate for these BF16 convolution computations. An actual full batch-2048 rerun exactly reproduced the original probabilities, and an actual batch-8192 rerun exactly reproduced the new probabilities on 13 aligned blocks (106496 rows), including the maximum-difference block. Within this evaluated sample every >0.5 decision was unchanged. Original between-batch differences remain explicitly recorded; no tolerance or reported probability was modified.
